publisher: District of Columbia Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection
ownership: Official Corporate Registration records published by DLCP through Open Data DC and the DCGIS ArcGIS FeatureServer
catalog_license_notice: The current harvested item metadata has also identified CC BY 4.0; this connector conservatively requires source attribution and a version note despite the broader District data terms.
open_api_policy: The District Transparency, Open Government and Open Data Directive says catalog datasets must use an open format retrievable through an open API and usable for automated processing.
source_access: Public anonymous HTTPS ArcGIS metadata, query, and catalog download endpoints exist. This implementation allows only exact metadata and aggregate/count-only live preflight forms; row acquisition is default-denied and unimplemented.
allowed_use: exact official layer metadata and aggregate/count-only preflight requests
acknowledged local processing of an operator-supplied exact selected-field active JSONL fixture
checksum-verified, non-overwriting internal selected-field fixture retention
local-review-only provisional organization and registration-status normalization
local-review-only administrative business-address evidence with ZIP5 and ZIP+4 kept separate
derived aggregate statistics only after privacy review and with source attribution, version date, checksum, and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: selecting, retaining, normalizing, or publishing EMAIL or any RA_* registered-agent name or address field
publishing person, contact, registered-agent, owner, officer, or member information
representing a business registration address as a verified physical site, establishment, storefront, occupancy, geometry, or geocode
representing either source-defined active status as independent proof of current operation, solvency, compliance, or public access
inferring ownership, control, parent-company, officer, member, agent, residence, or cross-source identity
joining ZIP5 and ZIP+4 in normalized postal_code or zip_code fields
record-level redistribution without a separate privacy, license, and data-quality approval
using District names or logos to imply endorsement
attribution: Source: District of Columbia Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection, Corporate Registration, via Open Data DC/DCGIS; include the source item ID, observation/version date, selected-field checksum, and applicable license/terms notice.
version_note: Every derived publication must identify item 5238c4fd99c843a1bd7679a243747a8c, the maximum DCS_LAST_MOD_DTTM observed, the selected schema fingerprint, and the source artifact SHA-256.
retention: Checksum-verified internal selected-field fixtures and non-overwriting local-review-only normalized releases may be retained under the approved project retention process. Filesystem immutability is not asserted. No public or production retention authorization is granted by this connector.
redistribution: CC0 District terms allow copying, modification, distribution, and commercial use unless otherwise noted, while current catalog metadata may identify CC BY 4.0. Apply the conservative attribution/version notice. Record-level redistribution remains disabled pending separate privacy and license review.
personal_data_handling: Business names can identify natural persons and business addresses can be residences. EMAIL and every RA_* field are excluded and prohibited. No person/contact/agent record, site, establishment, geometry, geocode, operation, or ownership inference is produced.
